## Workload

Lena Fischer completed the grading activity recorded for this review. The workload comprised 645 sets, undertaken across 336 hours. This equates to 1.9 sets per hour. The figures provide a clear summary of the volume handled and the time available for the work. They also establish the basis for considering the related quality findings.

## Quality

A further 34 sets were read again as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 61.8 per cent. This result was considered alongside the cases that required closer attention, including borderline background cases. Feedback was given on those cases to support consistency in grading and clarify the application of the relevant approach.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
